original_empirical_nuclear_sources.genetic_sample_duplicate_removed: SAMN44017865 / SRR30887251 had been included twice in older world53 as J38S038 plus GLB2, so all corrected-world52 real trees are freshly re-inferred
original_empirical_nuclear_sources.original_Moreyra_S1_role: molecular accession, BioSample, voucher and locality information, not same-author original nine Siniscalchi flower traits

supported_model_level_claim: Under the 4 stated homogeneous Mk CTMC process classes and equal initial root state prior, a bidirectional model fits observed taxon-level U/D states better than either one-way model across three true world52 nuclear gene panels, even though all trees reuse the same original 51 unique BioSamples. The one-way U-to-D-only process is much less penalized than D-to-U-only, but remains worse than reversible processes.
insufficient_claims: Actual observed independent D->U regained head orientation or recurrent U->D event counting
The ancestral global Cirsium head was definitely U or D; root state remains prior-driven in saturated reversible Mk models
D->U molecular gene pathway reversibility, ancestral anthocyanin expression or flower pigment reacquisition
The one-way-process AICc comparison proves ecological selection, historical precipitation/temperature, pollinator adaptation or migration
The corrected 52-tip, 176/75/73 gene panel represents the completed original 294 BioSample / final Moreyra 350-locus global species tree
Original sample collection regions are all physically Japanese for the Japan38 study grouping
methodological_limitations: AICc approximately uses n=27 distinct botanically scored species/varietal concepts, not independent experimental samples, and no formal demographic/spatial phylogenetic null supports irreversible-process statistical significance.
The initial original-45 continental molecular additions were partly ascertained by U/D; this biases source trait composition.
Twenty-four original molecular ingroup tips have no independent source-accepted U/D measurement and enter the Mk likelihood as unknown emission [1,1].

Mk rates are per DNA substitution/site, not per million years. Earlier exact Markov reward histories showed rate/branch-length saturation and huge hidden jumps not interpretable as actual biological origins.
AICc source trees from three gene panels are alternate estimates on the same 51 unique source BioSamples and not independent evolutionary replicates.
Source S1 provides taxon-level authoritative botanical head states from separate sources; it does not establish directly scored phenotypes on each sequenced herbarium voucher.
